“the Kribi-Camp-Ma’an region is characterized by many lineaments trending in the NE-SW, NNE-SSS, N-S, NW-SE, NW-SE and E-W directions”.
the gravity data analysis enables us to highlight many deeply seated structural features trending in NE, NNE N-S, NN, NW, NW-SE and E-W directions.
the Kribi area has a complex tectonic history and that the gravity data analysis enables the identification of several deeply-seated lineaments.

the study of gravity data acquired in the Kribian area.
a structural mapping in the Kribis-Campo-Maan area.
the study of the structural lineaments in the KCF area.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the gravity data analysis has enabled to highlight a major NW-SE trend which could have affected the NNE structure and to identify the local contacts of the NNE-SSS to N-S lineaments.
the gravity data processing enables to identify the main tectonic features in this region and that these features are related both to the Kribie-Campo shear zone and to the equatorial ocean opening.

the Kribi area is affected by the combined action of several tectonic processes which are the Kribi shears, the equatorial and Atlantic oceans opening, the Kribi basin and its N-S extension, and the Cameroon Line.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
this study area is affected by several tectonic events which have been responsible for its structural evolution.
the structural features of the study area are mainly controlled by the Kribi shears and the Kribi fault which is a local relay of the Kribian-Campian fault.

this study area is a complex tectonic region with a number of structural lineaments which have been identified from a multi-scale analysis of gravity data using the horizontal gradient magnitude (HGM) and Euler 3-D deconvolution approaches.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the gravity data can be used to identify deeply-seated structures which are not easily detectable from the surface.
the gravity method is an efficient and cost-effective tool in the delineation of structural lineaments.
the gravity data analysis enables the identification of many lineaments that are related to the major NNE-SSO to N-S structures.
